'''T8-C3''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] belonging to [[Cin Tykan]]'s expedition on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. It survived the attack on the expedition by the [[Death's Claw]] pirates and helped a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Knight]] track Tykan before returning to the Republic base.<ref name="TOR" />
